| What | Where | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| three.js r170 + addons (`GLTFLoader`, `SkeletonUtils`, `BufferGeometryUtils`, post-processing) | `vendor/` | three.js authors | MIT (`THREE_LICENSE`) |
| **Universal Base Characters** (male + female bodies) | `assets/hero/body_m.glb`, `body_f.glb` (stripped of eyes/hair, textures resized to 512 px, normals/roughness maps dropped) | Quaternius — https://quaternius.com | CC0 1.0 |
| **Universal Animation Library** (locomotion, jump, roll, punches, sword swing, spell casts, hit, death, dance) | `assets/hero/anims.glb` (16 clips kept, finger tracks dropped, resampled) | Quaternius — https://quaternius.com | CC0 1.0 |

CC0 means no credit is required; it is given here as a courtesy.

Everything that makes the game's characters recognisable is **original work in this repository**: the four costumes (zone-painted cloth,
runes, armour, masks, crowns), the elemental hair / cape / trail ribbons, the combat pose layer, all VFX, shaders and textures
(generated in code), the Training Grounds scenery, and all audio (synthesised with WebAudio — there are no audio files).
